'''Rawarok''' was a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] that lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They were once a slave to a band of [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]] from the [[Zssik Clan/Legends|Zssik Clan]], but escaped in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] with help from a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Rawarok appeared as a non-player character in the video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by Sony Online Entertainment and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.
